[She does not look at you. A full minute passes. Then, without turning:]

You moved four times while you waited. That is four times too many.

I know. I watched you cross the courtyard.

Everything I have to teach is inside the minute you just failed. You will be given
exactly one opening in most fights worth having. Not two. The Blessed who die young
are the ones who spend theirs early, on something that was never the throat.

Stand there. Do not move. When the market bell strikes, take one step forward.
Not before it. Not after.

[You wait. You wait past comfortable. The bell strikes. You step.]

That one was yours.

You will not, and you will take it anyway. That is the whole difficulty.

The sentry at the south gate, when you are ready. She has been ready for some time.
[She is watching the market bell. She does not turn.]
